title: Who We Are
paragraph_1: Bywater brings the ancient ritual of sauna to Seattle's most beautiful waterfront locations. We're building a third space where strangers become neighbors, and wellness meets authentic community.
paragraph_2: Bywater is not meant to be luxury, it's meant to be social. We offer outdoor sauna sessions at the beach where you can cycle between heat and cold at your own pace. Book a spot, show up with a towel, and experience the simple joy of shared heat and cold plunges with your community.
paragraph_3: This is wellness without the pretense. This is community by water.
